newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar closes broadly higher.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar closes broadly higher.

text.p: White sugar futures were supported by late buying to end Thursday broadly higher after giving up earlier modest losses.
The market had been weighed down by scale-up selling which capped the recent gains racked up on the front-month October contract.
October, the volume leader, finished unchanged at $328.00 per tonne after ranging between $326.80 and $328.40.
Other traded months gained between 70 cents and $2.00. The slight improvement followed a similar trend in New York raws market.
The day's volume stood at 2,674 lots, of which 1,541 were in October. Again there were no fresh fundamental inputs.
